correctness.rationale: Every proper face of P_n maximizes some coordinate functional and is F_{I,J}=conv{e_i-e_j:i∈I,j∈J} for unique ordered disjoint nonempty I,J; it is a product of simplices of dimension |I|+|J|-2, using maximum and minimum coordinate sets. Because u_i are pairwise distinct, no root vertex lies on <u,x>=0. The hyperplane intersects relint F precisely when u_i-u_j takes both signs on I×J, equivalently minrank(I)<maxrank(J) and minrank(J)<maxrank(I). Every proper nonempty face of the section arises exactly from the unique ambient minimal face whose relative interior it cuts; dimensions decrease by one and inclusion corresponds to coordinatewise I,J inclusion. For union cardinal m=k+3>=3 there are 2^m-2 nonempty oriented bipartitions minus 2(m-1) contiguous ordered initial/final splits, yielding 2^m-2m and thus f_k=C(n,k+3)(2^(k+3)-2(k+3)); the generating identity follows by binomial theorem. Vertices are crossings of root edges from ordered triples a<b<c, giving two opposite points; alternation I,J,I or J,I,J counts vertices in each face. Independently enumerated all oriented partitions for n3..9 and checked formula; at n5 facet polygon sizes exactly 10 triangles, 10 quadrilaterals and 2 pentagons. This is an all-n proof by ambient face intersection, not finite regression.
residual_risks: Ambient section-face uniqueness needs transversality ensured by no zero root vertices; pairwise distinct normal coordinates supply exactly that.
No claim about nongeneric or noncentral hyperplanes.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge distinct complete face-poset and f-vector formula for all generic *central sections* of the complete type-A root polytope. Ardila et al and Cellini-Marietti present the unsectioned root polytope faces/f-vector; the latter computes a related arrangement of hyperplanes spanned by codimension-2 root faces, not the face lattice of a hyperplane intersection. Distinct published results on positive-root tournaments and random central cube sections do not cover this centrally cut signed-root polytope. The full law is elementary given ambient faces, but no inspected prior states the interleaved bipartition condition/all-rank counts; value remains the complete natural classification.
residual_risks: The full ambient root-polytope face lattice is classical; an earlier hyperplane-section corollary under an alternate combinatorial name may imply the interleaving law.
The claim is generic central section only: no tied normal coordinates or offset sections; finite n<=9 count checks do not prove all n.

value.rationale: The full face lattice of a natural all-rank family of generic central sections, not just an f-vector, is an exact structural invariant useful in root-polytope combinatorics. Uniform independence from numerical normal values, an explicit interleaved poset and alternating-triple local-face spectrum offer more than a textbook restatement of the original root-polytope f-vector. The exact m-dependent face formula and n5 facet spectrum answer a natural classification for an already important symmetric polytope.
residual_risks: Proof is short and uses classical ambient face structure; prior generic section corollaries may exist in unindexed combinatorial geometry literature.
